description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the help module, including help page rendering, theme definitions, block alterations, and module/theme installation/uninstallation handlers.

classes.name: HelpHooks
classes.description: A class implementing Drupal hooks related to the help module, including help page rendering, theme, block, and module/theme lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Handles rendering of help pages based on route name, generating HTML content for help topics.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hook implementations for help sections and topics.

methods.name: blockViewHelpBlockAlter
methods.description: Alters the help block view to remove contextual links.

methods.name: modulesUninstalled
methods.description: Handles cleanup when modules are uninstalled, updating help search index.

methods.name: themesUninstalled
methods.description: Handles cleanup when themes are uninstalled, clearing cache and updating help search index.

methods.name: modulesInstalled
methods.description: Handles actions after modules are installed, updating help search index.

methods.name: themesInstalled
methods.description: Handles actions after themes are installed, clearing cache and updating help search index.
